changes.title: Authorities identify 5 victims killed when Amazon-branded cargo plane overran runway in Miami
changes.summary: An airline cleaning company was mourning the loss of five employees who were identified as those killed Sunday when an Amazon-branded cargo plane overran the runway at Miami International Airport, striking the company’s van and a passenger SUV.

changes.title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overruns Runway in Miami, Killing at Least 5
changes.summary: At least five people were killed and several others injured when an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday. Officials said the aircraft struck multiple vehicles before stopping near a parking lot, triggering a ground stop and widespread flight disruptions. NBC’s George So.
